tasks.label: Run Saptha Portal
args: const http=require("http"),fs=require("fs"),path=require("path");const root=process.cwd(),types={".html":"text/html; charset=utf-8",".js":"text/javascript; charset=utf-8",".css":"text/css; charset=utf-8",".png":"image/png",".jpg":"image/jpeg",".json":"application/json"};http.createServer((req,res)=>{const pathname=decodeURIComponent(new URL(req.url,"http://localhost").pathname),relative=pathname==="/"?"index.html":pathname.slice(1),file=path.resolve(root,relative);if(file!==root&&!file.startsWith(root+path.sep)){res.writeHead(403).end("Forbidden");return}fs.stat(file,(error,stat)=>{if(error||!stat.isFile()){res.writeHead(404).end("Not found");return}res.writeHead(200,{"Content-Type":types[path.extname(file)]||"application/octet-stream"});fs.createReadStream(file).pipe(res)})}).listen(5173,"127.0.0.1",()=>console.log("SAPTHA Portal running at http://127.0.0.1:5173"))
